rainfall_basis: Compare forecast monthly total with the same calendar month's 2000–2021 ERA5 mean. This is a planning trigger, not a crop damage threshold or an official above/below-normal category.

preparation.en: Choose ground that does not flood and make sure excess water can drain away.
preparation.fil: Pumili ng lupang hindi binabaha at tiyaking may daluyan ang sobrang tubig.

preparation.en: Prepare a reliable water supply for your planting area.
preparation.fil: Maghanda ng sapat at maaasahang suplay ng tubig para sa taniman.

preparation.en: Use loose soil and adjust watering to the soil moisture and weather.
preparation.fil: Gumamit ng buhaghag na lupa at iayon ang pagdidilig sa halumigmig ng lupa at panahon.

preparation.en: For upland Kangkong, keep the soil moist. Water after planting, then daily or as needed.
preparation.fil: Para sa upland na Kangkong, panatilihing mamasa-masa ang lupa. Diligan pagkatapos magtanim, at araw-araw o kung kailangan.

preparation.en: Prepare soil mixed with compost and water regularly as needed.
preparation.fil: Maghanda ng lupang may halong compost at regular na diligan kung kailangan.

preparation.en: Use loose soil rich in organic matter and water as needed.
preparation.fil: Gumamit ng buhaghag na lupang mayaman sa organikong bagay at diligan kung kailangan.

preparation.en: Use soil that drains well and prepare a water supply for irrigation.
preparation.fil: Gumamit ng lupang maayos ang daluyan ng tubig at maghanda ng patubig.

preparation.en: Prepare fertile soil with good drainage and enough irrigation, especially during dry weather.
preparation.fil: Maghanda ng matabang lupang maayos ang daluyan ng tubig at sapat na patubig, lalo na sa tuyong panahon.

preparation.en: Use soil that drains well. Water after sowing and keep the soil from drying out.
preparation.fil: Gumamit ng lupang maayos ang daluyan ng tubig. Diligan pagkatapos maghasik at iwasang matuyo ang lupa.

preparation.en: Choose a planting area that does not flood. Water after transplanting and then as needed.
preparation.fil: Pumili ng tanimang hindi binabaha. Diligan pagkatapos maglipat-tanim at kung kailangan.

preparation.en: Prepare enough water for the crop and add compost to the soil.
preparation.fil: Maghanda ng sapat na tubig para sa pananim at lagyan ng compost ang lupa.

preparation.en: Water in the morning and make sure water does not collect around the plants.
preparation.fil: Diligan sa umaga at tiyaking hindi naiipon ang tubig sa paligid ng mga halaman.

preparation.en: Water frequently and keep excess water draining away.
preparation.fil: Regular na diligan at panatilihing umaagos palabas ang sobrang tubig.

preparation.en: Prepare loose soil with organic matter and enough irrigation for dry growing periods.
preparation.fil: Maghanda ng buhaghag na lupang may organikong bagay at sapat na patubig para sa tuyong panahon.

preparation.en: Confirm whether your variety is for upland or lowland planting; the water needs differ. Ask CENRO about your growing setup.
preparation.fil: Tiyakin kung para sa upland o lowland ang barayti; magkaiba ang pangangailangan sa tubig. Magtanong sa CENRO tungkol sa iyong taniman.

preparation.en: Water after planting and prepare drainage for heavy rain.
preparation.fil: Diligan pagkatapos magtanim at maghanda ng daluyan ng tubig para sa malakas na ulan.

preparation.en: Prepare loose, sandy soil and use divided rhizomes as planting material.
preparation.fil: Maghanda ng buhaghag at mabuhanging lupa at gumamit ng hinating rhizome bilang pantanim.

preparation.en: Use fertile soil that drains well. Water while the plant is getting established.
preparation.fil: Gumamit ng matabang lupang maayos ang daluyan ng tubig. Diligan habang nagsisimula pa lamang lumaki ang halaman.

preparation.en: Provide enough water and make sure excess water can drain away. Prepare a trellis for the vines.
preparation.fil: Maghanda ng sapat na tubig at tiyaking may daluyan ang sobrang tubig. Maghanda ng balag para sa mga baging.
